Team — technical note on telemetry artifact:

- What I will produce: a 72-hour sample extract of request/response telemetry for the Greenridge tenant, redacted to remove PII and full prompt/response payloads. The sample will include: request timestamps, endpoint, anonymized request_id, token counts, and error flags.
- Retention/rotation note: our production telemetry is retained at the per-tenant rollup level for 90 days; raw token-level traces are archived for 30 days then purged unless preserved for an incident. We can include a screenshot/excerpt of the retention policy and the log lifecycle flow.
- Constraints: If the customer needs line-level prompts/responses we need explicit signed approval and a short checklist from Legal.

Attachment: [Attachment: prod-telemetry-log-sample.pdf (PDF stub, 450KB)]
